contamination._comment: Applied to every worktree of every arm, identically, so the sanitized state is still byte-identical across arms. A second harness's planning guidance in the same session can mask the ablated rule and manufacture a false null.

strip_blocks._comment: The OMC block in CLAUDE.md restates the invariants kein's ralplan enforces — separate authoring and review passes, never self-approve in the same context, verify before claiming. A control arm that keeps this is not skill-absent, and the calibration's expected difference collapses. The markers are explicit, so the project's own instructions below them survive intact.
